question: Should `applySessionModelSelection` become a permanent public plugin SDK contract now, or remain core-internal until a concrete channel picker implementation needs it?
rationale: The choice determines a durable external API and its compatibility burden; the branch’s behavior-neutral Phase 1 rationale alone does not establish the long-term plugin contract.

options.title: Keep the API internal for Phase 1
options.body: Retain the shared core service but remove its plugin SDK export until a channel migration establishes the minimal external contract.

options.title: Stabilize the public API now
options.body: Keep the SDK export, document its supported callers and upgrade guarantees, and add compatibility coverage for plugin consumers.

recommendation.title: Keep the API internal for Phase 1
recommendation.body: Retain the shared core service but remove its plugin SDK export until a channel migration establishes the minimal external contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR presents the architecture and its staged plugin-facing rollout, making this the closest available decision-routing candidate.
